headlines.label: Overtakes
headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: ANT (7)

summary: Oscar Piastri won the Belgian Grand Prix from P2 on the grid, 3.4s ahead of Lando Norris, with Charles Leclerc completing the podium.
Lewis Hamilton made the biggest climb, from P18 to P7.
Isack Hadjar had a day to forget, dropping from P8 to P20.
The race was neutralised by 1 red flag.
There were 26 pit stops in total; the winner stopped once.
Rain fell at some point during the race.
Oscar Piastri leads the championship by 16 points over Lando Norris.
